data.text: All invoices, columns id, customer, amount, status and due date. Done when the file has one row per invoice.
data.question:
Two quick ones before I plan it.
- Which invoices and which columns go in the file, and where does the button live? I'd say all invoices; id, customer, amount, status, due date; a button above the invoices table.
- What check proves it works? I'd use: a header row, then one row per invoice with the amount in dollars, covered by a test.
